name: CENTERPOINT ENERGY INC

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-19), Note 8(a) Stock-Based Incentive Compensation Plans, table summarizing expenses related to LTIPs: 'LTIP compensation expense' $48 million for FY2025, with $34 million for FY2024 and $65 million for FY2023 in the same table (in millions), stated as included in Operation and maintenance expense, net of any amounts capitalized. The engine's SBC tags (ShareBasedCompensation / AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense) carry no values for CNP in EDGAR companyfacts for any period, and the 10-K Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows present no separate stock-compensation line — the Note 8(a) table is the filer's own reported stock-based compensation expense.
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc — SBC missing for fiscal years 2023, 2024, 2025 of the last 3 (in fact all years in the filed history under the engine's tags). The filer's own reported FY2025 LTIP (stock-based) compensation expense fills the gap; the engine applies this single value to every missing period. The true per-year filing series is $65M (FY2023) / $34M (FY2024) / $48M (FY2025); the median year of the last-3 base is FY2025 itself, so the normalized base is unchanged versus the true series, and any difference on the other years is at most $17M (~$0.03/share) — immaterial against FY2025 OCF of $2,486M and capex of $4,870M. The note figure is net of amounts capitalized, so if anything it understates total stock-comp cost — a floor, not an overstatement.

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Utilities sector — OE/capex DCF fits utilities names poorly; grade confidence low

The engine's SBC tags (ShareBasedCompensation / AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense) carry no values for CNP in EDGAR companyfacts for any period, and the 10-K Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows present no separate stock-compensation line — the Note 8(a) table is the filer's own reported stock-based compensation expense.); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
note: No positive NORMALIZED (3-yr median) conservative owner's earnings — OE DCF not supportable on numbers alone. If the latest year alone is positive, that is a flag to investigate, not a pass.

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
